sourceReview.finding: 87.6% occupied-cell overlap. Beacon uses a moving perimeter patrol; Lasting replaces that pressure with a required permanent relay and a territory eroder. Opening the relay versus removing the eroder is a different native objective order, not an artwork swap.
78.6% overlap. Archive has a required relay and two field keepers; Passing has two perimeter patrols and one keeper. The departure, return and required-objective pressures differ.
74.6% overlap. Warning Shift locks horizontal attack warnings to an owned cut; Tailwind has two directional fields and no emitter. The return-speed and warning-window decisions differ.

acceptance: Distinct authored mechanics confirmed for the closest occupied-cell pairs; paired human pacing and enjoyment review remains outstanding.
